notes.title: Ultrawings Flat is now released!
notes.content:
Hey all!

We're releasing the Flat version of our popular VR game, Ultrawings, TODAY!

What are the differences (other than the obvious)?

-- We've added external cameras to increase spacial awareness while flying.

-- We've rebalanced pretty much every mission in the game to account for playing on Flat screens.

-- Simplified aircraft start-up procedure to a single button.

-- Altered the UI to account for Flat screens.

HOTAS users:

Please pay special attention to the list of HOTAS the game currently supports.  If your HOTAS or joystick is not on this list the game will likely either not detect it or mapping may not work properly.

In the coming days we plan on adding support for a few more (Logitech Extreme Pro, for instance).

If you have any issues please don't hesitate to reach out to us at support@bitplanetgames.com.

Happy Flying!
